@@U01291@@
If ’'m any judge of such things,
his mind wandered wildly as he gasped his last.
“T never had time to kill,” said he;
“first to get children for her,
and then bread for them all—
bread in the very broadest sense—and then
not have time to eat my share in peace.”

@@U01293@@
He forgot, did he, my loyalty to him, my love,
slaving away for him day and night?

@@U01295@@
Not so, no, never, he thought of you fondly.
Said he: “When I sailed out from Malta,
I prayed hard for wife and children;
and then Heaven blessed us:
we captured a Turkish vessel that had in its hold
a treasure of great Sultan himself.
Bravery’s reward then came due,
and I got my share.”

@@U01297@@
What's that?
What? Where?
Did he bury it?

@@U01299@@
Who knows where the four winds have blown it?
One day as he strolled through Naples,
a lovely young miss took him to her heart.
She showed him so much love and loyalty
that he felt it till the day he died.

@@U01301@@
Oh! The scoundrel! The wretch!
Stealing from his own children, he did!
No misery, no poverty
could check his scandalous life!
translation:
@@U01291@@
如果对此类事情有任何判断，
当他咽下最后一口气时，他的思绪疯狂地游荡。
“我从来没有时间去杀戮，”他说。
“首先要为她生孩子，
然后为他们所有人提供面包——
最广泛意义上的面包——然后
没有时间安静地吃我的那一份。”

@@U01293@@
他忘记了，是吗，我对他的忠诚，我的爱，
日夜为他操劳？

@@U01295@@
不是这样，不，从来没有，他深情地想着你。
他说：“当我从马耳他启航时，
我为妻子和孩子努力祈祷；
然后上天保佑我们：
我们捕获了一艘土耳其船只
伟大苏丹本人的珍宝。
勇敢的奖赏到了，
我得到了我的那一份。”

@@U01297@@
那是什么？
什么？在哪里？
他把它埋了吗？

@@U01299@@
谁知道四风把它吹到哪里去了？
有一天，当他在那不勒斯漫步时，
一位可爱的小姐把他放在心上。
她向他展示了如此多的爱和忠诚
直到他去世的那一天他都感受到了这一点。

@@U01301@@
哦！恶棍！这个可怜虫！
他偷了自己孩子的东西，他确实这么做了！
没有苦难，没有贫穷
可以检查他的丑闻生活！
